capabilities: Create playlists from a vault folder by recursively indexing audio files
Create playlists from external links, including YouTube embeds
Control playback with shuffle, repeat, seek, volume, and fade-out stop
Adjust audio with a 10-band equalizer and three editable presets
Assign hotkeys to per-playlist play/pause commands
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community store; install manually or via BRAT. External link playback may be blocked by some services, and mobile behavior depends on OS media policies. Author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play audio files as playlists or stream audio from external links inside the app.

relations.evidence: If you use the BRAT plugin
Assigns privacy-enhanced domain for youtube embeds to help with Error 153

summary: Audio player that builds playlists from vault folders or external links and plays them in a tab view plus a footer mini-player.
